Fetched: 2026-07-28

The volume-restriction envelope (Finding A, Engram #4690): HTTP 200 with
a JSON OBJECT body, whereas a successful DATOS_TABLA/DATOS_SERIE response
is a JSON ARRAY/object with "Nombre"/"Data" fields respectively. Note the
spacing around the colon in the raw body -- preserved byte-for-byte as
observed live, not reformatted.

This client never calls DATOS_TABLA (ADR-2/D5 — ingestion uses
DATOS_SERIE/{COD} exclusively; DATOS_TABLA/SERIES_TABLA are
discovery-only). This fixture is checked in as a first-class test case
anyway, per spec source-ingestion-ine's "the envelope MUST be a
first-class fixture": the decoder that guards against it is generic
(keyed on the "status" field's presence, not on which endpoint was
called), so this is the fixture that proves the decoder is a real
discriminating guard, not a coincidence of DATOS_SERIE's own shape.
